title: Oscillation of partial sums of the Möbius function and zeros of Riemann's zeta function
summary: The oscillation of M(x), the partial sum of the Möbius function has been in the focus of researchers in the theory of primes since the famous conjecture of Mertens in 1905 (formulated in a weaker form by Stieltjes in 1885 in a letter to Hermite). The average order of the modulus of M(x) in an interval of type [0,Y] is clearly in connection with the distribution of primes. The author proved at the beginning of 1980's that this average tends unconditionally to infinity with Y.
